mapper.select: select p.pro_id as "proId", p.pro_name as "proName", p.pro_status as "proStatus", p.end_date as "endDate", e.emp_name as "empName" from project p join employee e on p.emp_id = e.emp_id where p.com_id = #{comId} and p.pro_status in ('TODO', 'DOING') and p.end_date >= trunc(sysdate) order by p.end_date asc FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

select distinct p.pro_id as "proId", p.pro_name as "proName", p.pro_status as "proStatus", p.end_date as "endDate", e.emp_name as "empName" from project p join employee e on p.emp_id = e.emp_id left join project_member pm on pm.project_pro_id = p.pro_id where p.com_id = #{comId} and p.pro_status in ('TODO', 'DOING') and p.end_date >= trunc(sysdate) and (p.emp_id = #{empId} or pm.emp_id = #{empId}) order by p.end_date asc FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
